description: Restructure app/page.tsx section order and cleanup — remove TrustStrip, Pricing, Advantages; reorder to Hero → Projects → Capabilities → Process → BeyondWork → About → Testimonials (conditional) → FAQ → Contact; update Footer nav links
steps: 1. Update app/page.tsx imports: Remove imports for TrustStrip, Pricing, Advantages. Add import for BeyondWork from @/components/beyond-work. Update the Services import comment/usage to reflect it's now 'capabilities' (optional comment, but be aware).

2. Update app/page.tsx readData calls in the Promise.all: Remove advantagesData fetch (remove it from the array and the destructure). Keep all other fetches: content, availability, processData, testimonialsData, servicesData, faqData, projectsData.

3. Update app/page.tsx return JSX: Reorder sections in this exact order: <Navbar />, <main>, <Hero />, <Projects />, <Services /> (capabilities), <Process />, <BeyondWork />, <About />, conditional <Testimonials /> (wrap with {testimonialsData.length > 0 && <Testimonials ... />}), <FAQ />, <Contact />, </main>, <Footer />. Remove <TrustStrip />, <Pricing />, <Advantages /> entirely. Ensure all kept components receive their required props (availability, hero, projects for Hero; images and initialData for Projects; initialData for Services, Process, FAQ; site for Contact; site for Footer; initialData for Testimonials).

4. Update components/footer.tsx navLinks array: Remove 'Pricing' entry. Update 'Services' to 'Capabilities' with href='#capabilities' (or keep href='#services' if Services component still uses id='services' — check FEAT-002 result). The final navLinks should be: Work (#work), Capabilities (#capabilities), About (#about), Process (#process), Contact (#contact). Remove any other stale links.
acceptance_criteria: app/page.tsx imports BeyondWork, does not import TrustStrip/Pricing/Advantages
app/page.tsx renders sections in the order: Hero, Projects, Services, Process, BeyondWork, About, Testimonials (conditional), FAQ, Contact
components/footer.tsx navLinks array does not include 'Pricing', includes 'Capabilities' (or updated equivalent)
No TypeScript errors, no unused imports warnings
verification: Run 'npm run dev' and open http://localhost:3000

Scroll through the page and confirm section order: Hero at top, then Projects, then Capabilities/Services, then Process, then Beyond Work (new section with 3 cards), then About, then Testimonials (if any exist), then FAQ, then Contact
Confirm TrustStrip (logos/badges), Pricing (plans/cards), and Advantages (benefits grid) sections do NOT appear on the page
Check Footer navigation links — 'Pricing' link should not be present, 'Capabilities' or 'Services' link should exist and scroll to the correct section
Click each footer nav link and confirm it scrolls to the correct section
No console errors, no 'Component not found' errors
findings: Successfully restructured app/page.tsx to remove TrustStrip, Pricing, and Advantages components. Added BeyondWork component import and usage. Reordered sections to: Hero → Projects → Services (capabilities) → Process → BeyondWork → About → Testimonials (conditional) → FAQ → Contact. Updated Footer navLinks to replace 'Services' with 'Capabilities' (#capabilities) and removed 'Pricing' link. Testimonials now only renders when testimonialsData.length > 0. All imports updated correctly, no unused imports remain. Note: Build verification was blocked by PowerShell execution policy, but manual code review confirms all TypeScript syntax is correct, imports are valid, and component props are properly passed.
